high_level_description: The image shows two women standing side by side in front of a large abstract painting. The painting features a vibrant mix of colors including pinks, blues, greens, and blacks, with various shapes and patterns that appear to be abstract representations of buildings or structures. The woman on the left has long brown hair and is wearing a black button-up shirt paired with black pants. She accessorizes with a gold necklace and a bracelet on her right wrist. Her posture is relaxed, with one hand resting on her hip and the other slightly bent at the elbow.
